- Used Tween animations, curved transitions, and gesture-based effects for a dynamic experience.
- Designed animated product cards, cart transitions, and custom UI components.
- Focused on responsive design to ensure smooth performance across various screen sizes.

## Sports Booking App

## Flutter | Firebase | Google Maps API | Riverpod | Payment Gateway | MVVM | Whatsapp | php | mysql

- Applied the MVVM architecture for code scalability and maintainability.
- Integrated Google Maps, Directions, Places APIs, and WhatsApp messaging for enhanced UX.
- Implemented payment gateway, booking calendar, and push notifications.
- Ensured high-performance even with large datasets and bookings.
- Delivered a fully responsive UI tailored for seamless multi-device usage.
